watches.name: Gym bundle seeds M-L
watches.target_type: men's gym clothing suitable for building a multi-item bundle
watches.notes: Individual item value can be modest. Looking for sellers with several useful men's gym pieces in M/L. H&M Sport/Move, Craft, Nike, Adidas, Under Armour, Puma, Reebok, Decathlon technical lines and similar are acceptable if several good-condition pieces can be bundled cheaply.

watches.name: Lululemon gym M-L
watches.notes: Prioritise Pace Breaker, License to Train, Metal Vent Tech and other technical training lines. A merely good Craft-tier alternative should lose to a true Lululemon steal. Generic casual pieces are skips.

watches.name: Ten Thousand gym M-L
watches.notes: Interval, Session, Tactical and other genuine Ten Thousand training pieces only.

watches.name: Rhone gym M-L
watches.notes: Premium technical training apparel. Prefer Reign, Commuter and similar lines in excellent condition.

watches.name: Vuori gym M-L
watches.notes: Technical tees, shorts and pants. Prefer Kore, Strato, Sunday Performance.

watches.name: Tracksmith gym M-L
watches.notes: Premium running/training pieces only. Strong absolute saving vs new required.

watches.name: Saysky running M-L
watches.notes: Technical running pieces with meaningful discount. Skip basic logo tees.

watches.name: Falke ESS M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical training or running clothing
watches.notes: Falke ESS / technical performance lines only. Ordinary socks alone are not a keep.

watches.name: Craft ADV M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical gym or running clothing
watches.notes: ADV and PRO lines only. A merely good 120 RON Craft tee is a skip — wait for exceptional steals or better brands.

watches.name: Odlo technical M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical gym, running or base-layer clothing
watches.notes: Performance, Zeroweight, Blackcomb and premium technical lines preferred. Skip ordinary basics.

watches.name: GOREWEAR M-L
watches.target_type: men's technical training or running clothing
watches.notes: Genuinely technical pieces only — not basic logo tees.

watches.name: 2XU M-L
watches.notes: Compression tights, shorts and technical tops. Excellent condition required.

watches.name: New Balance 990 size 43
watches.notes: Prefer Made in USA 990v4, v5 or v6. Condition and sole wear matter heavily. Reject suspicious fakes.

watches.name: New Balance 991 size 43
watches.notes: Made in UK models preferred. Strong authenticity check required.

watches.name: New Balance 993 size 43
watches.notes: Made in USA. Reject heavily worn heel, outsole or lining.

watches.name: New Balance 2002R size 43
watches.notes: Only alert on unusually strong price and condition. Ordinary used-market 2002R is a skip.

watches.name: New Balance 1906R size 43
watches.notes: Only very good price and condition. Reject heavily worn pairs.

watches.name: ASICS Gel Kayano 14 size 43
watches.notes: Authenticity is important because this model is frequently replicated.

watches.name: ASICS GT-2160 size 43
watches.notes: Good condition and meaningful discount required.

watches.name: ASICS Gel-1130 size 43
watches.notes: Only outstanding price/condition. Skip ordinary used pairs.

watches.name: Diadora Heritage size 43
watches.notes: Heritage / premium Diadora lifestyle models only. Strong condition and absolute saving required.

watches.name: Johnstons of Elgin M-L
watches.notes: Genuine Johnstons cashmere/knit. Large retail-to-resale gap expected. Reject moth damage and cheap blends.

watches.name: Cruciani M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium knitwear or knit polo
watches.notes: Premium Italian knit. Skip low-value accessories unless exceptional.

watches.name: Gran Sasso M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium knitwear or knit polo
watches.notes: Merino and high-quality Italian knitwear preferred.

watches.name: Fedeli M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium knitwear, polo or T-shirt
watches.notes: Merino, cashmere and premium cotton. Strong condition required.

watches.name: Sunspel M-L
watches.target_type: men's premium T-shirt, polo or knitwear
watches.notes: Classic premium T-shirts, polos and merino. Avoid underwear unless unusually compelling.

watches.name: Zimmerli polo M-L
watches.notes: Premium Swiss basics. Sellers often underprice these as 'simple polos' — reward true steals only.

watches.name: Hanro polo M-L
watches.notes: Premium cotton polos/tees. Skip ordinary underwear packs.

watches.name: Merz b. Schwanen M-L
watches.notes: Loopwheel / premium basic tees. Only unusually strong price-quality.

watches.name: CDLP M-L
watches.notes: Premium basics. Skip multipacks of low interest; favour exceptional single pieces.

watches.name: Devold merino M-L
watches.target_type: men's merino T-shirt, long sleeve or technical layer
watches.notes: Prioritise genuine high-merino technical pieces.

watches.name: Smartwool merino M-L
watches.notes: Technical merino layers preferred. Skip ordinary socks unless exceptional.

watches.name: Ortovox merino M-L
watches.notes: Alpine technical merino. Strong absolute saving vs new required.

watches.name: Woolpower merino M-L
watches.notes: Swedish technical merino base layers. Excellent condition preferred.

watches.name: Cashmere pure wildcard M-L
watches.notes: Stricter complement to Cashmere broad. Only genuinely high-quality pure cashmere from a credible maker.

A 70 RON true Seraphine dress in great condition can be a keep. Prefer dresses, workwear, coats, knitwear, trousers and nursing-compatible pieces.
